title: ProposalArtifact
description: A deploy-ready, self-justifying proposal emitted by a verdict tool when format='proposal' (Finding #35). Carries LOCAL metadata-API files (package.xml and/or destructiveChanges.xml) plus an evidence trail. sfi PROPOSES these files for a human to review and feed to their own deploy tool (Gearset / Copado / `sf project deploy`); it NEVER deploys, writes, or connects to the org. REVIEW before deploy: analysis is against the last vault refresh, not live prod.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this schema the payload conforms to.

kind.description: `destructive` = a destructiveChanges.xml delete bundle; `deploy` = a package.xml deploy bundle.

headline.description: One-line human summary of what the proposal does.

files.description: The local files the host writes (or prints). sfi never writes them itself.

skipped.description: Ids dropped as malformed or synthetic/non-deployable graph nodes, with the reason.

disclosure.description: Verbatim, always-present REVIEW-before-deploy / local-file-only disclosure. Also rendered as the leading XML comment inside every generated file.

contents.description: Full file text, including the leading `<!-- sfi proposal … -->` evidence comment.

verdict.description: The tool's verdict/confidence for this proposal (e.g. `safe`, `blocking`, `high`).

sourceTreeHash.description: The vault sourceTreeHash the analysis ran against.

reasons.description: Per-finding evidence lines, each naming its confidence where relevant.

disclosures.description: The tool's boundaries[] / coverage-caveat text, carried verbatim.
